unit: Center for Conservation Medicine (CCM), Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine
notes: Cross-cutting interdisciplinary center (not a department of its own labs): its page names no individual PI-led labs, only educational/clinical programs (M.S. in Conservation Medicine, Wildlife Conservation Medicine, International Veterinary Medicine) and the Tufts Wildlife Clinic. Center faculty are drawn from Comparative Pathobiology (tufts-vet-cp.json) and Infectious Disease & Global Health (tufts-vet-idgh.json), already recorded there -- not duplicated here. General contact: mcm@tufts.edu, 508-887-4812, 200 Westboro Road, North Grafton, MA 01536. Tufts CCM is a founding member of the Consortium for Conservation Medicine with EcoHealth Alliance, the National Wildlife Health Center, and Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health.
